items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: they formed a band, they called it the Creole Serenade, with Peter Volcar and Dwight Newman and Charlie and Henry

ctx.x: Good drummer, good drummer. He played a while, before you run out, when we, Pierron Brookerby's old band, and they formed a band, they called it the Creole Serenade, with Peter Volcar and Dwight Newman and Charlie and Henry, they had six pieces, Henry Zeno was their drummer. I forgot about that.
